endorsements.name: Chris Inzinga
endorsements.label: CVE-2019-25329
endorsements.description: FTP Navigator 8.03 contains a denial of service vulnerability that allows attackers to crash the application by overwriting Structured Exception Handler (SEH) with malicious input. Attackers can generate a payload of 4108 'A' characters followed by 4 'B' characters and 40 'C' characters to trigger a program crash when pasted into the custom command input.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: HIGH (CVSS 3.1, 7.5)

povs.explanation: A published CVE record provides public, independently verifiable recognition of the credited vulnerability disclosure.

endorsements.name: Chris Inzinga
endorsements.label: CVE-2019-25330
endorsements.description: SurfOffline Professional 2.2.0.103 contains a structured exception handler (SEH) overflow vulnerability that allows attackers to crash the application by manipulating the project name input. Attackers can generate a malicious payload of 382 'A' characters followed by specific byte sequences to trigger a denial of service condition and overwrite SEH registers.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: HIGH (CVSS 3.1, 7.5)
